summary: Iteration 4 — Compliance & Safety Layer fully tested end-to-end. 8/8 backend pytest cases pass: GET /api/policy public + full schema + exact first principle, DELETE /api/account auth-gated + full cascade delete (user_leads, messages, invoices, verified_by[]), AI message output has no spam/guarantee phrases, lead scoring still emits spam_score/spam_flags. Frontend: /compliance screen renders all 8 sections with checkmarks; Profile shows How LeadForge Works + Delete Account rows; Message Generator shows manual-send-banner with the exact required text; back-btn works. No critical issues found.
action_items: Optional: section header 'WHAT WE DON'T STORE' is rendered as part of the same card as 'WHAT WE STORE' (visible in screenshots, just no separate header text). Not a defect — informational only.
Optional: the legacy /api/auth/toggle-premium still mutates is_premium independently from billing — same comment as iter3.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1477 lines — splitting policy/account/billing/AI/leads into modules would improve maintainability.

delete_account hard-deletes without a soft-delete grace period or audit log — by design per problem statement, but consider logging deleted user_id + counts to a separate audit collection for support/compliance traceability.
delete_account: if Razorpay subscription cancel raises, we log and continue — good, but we don't capture the exception in the response. Acceptable since user data is still removed.
POLICY_DOC is hard-coded in server.py — fine for v1 but as policy text grows it should move to a JSON/markdown file under /app/backend/static or a CMS-backed collection.
AI prompts now contain anti-spam constraints inline — verified via output check. Consider extracting the system prompt into a constant for easier audit/version control.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (compliance screen, profile rows, message banner, back button all verified)

seed_data_creation: Test creates throwaway TEST_compliance_<uuid>@leadforge.io users via /api/auth/register inside test_full_delete_cascade and removes them via DELETE /api/account in the same test — no residual data. Main test@leadforge.io user untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter4 compliance layer fully verified. Backend: GET /api/policy returns full POLICY_DOC (version 1.0, 5 principles, 6 data_collected items, 3 data_not_collected items, 4 user_rights, 4 rate_limits tiers free/minimum/professional/expert, support@leadforge.app). DELETE /api/account requires Bearer auth (401 without), cascades to user_leads/messages/invoices and pulls user from verified_by[] arrays. AI generate-message uses tone literal Formal/Casual/Persuasive (NOT Friendly). Endpoint paths: /api/leads/feed (not /api/leads), /api/userleads (not /api/user-leads), /api/leads/{id}/mark-verified is the toggle for verified_by[], /api/leads/{id}/verify runs reputation+freshness check. Frontend testIDs: how-it-works-btn (Profile→/compliance), delete-account-btn (Profile, red border, web uses window.confirm), back-btn (compliance + message screens), manual-send-banner (Message screen, exact text 'You must initiate this outreach manually. LeadForge never sends messages on your behalf.'). Login testIDs are login-email-input/login-password-input/login-submit-btn. Lead card prefix: lead-card-<id>. Generate message btn: generate-message-btn on lead detail.
